title: The AutoDiag web dashboard
keywords: autodiag dashboard web ui browser tabs overview topics graph compare hosts transport assistant tools settings export snapshot download report serve start open browser url
text: dds-autodiag serve --open starts the dashboard at http://127.0.0.1:8080. The process you opened is always this host; a peer is a snapshot or another serve you connect to under Hosts. Tabs: Overview (status, key facts and findings), Topics (every topic, endpoints, QoS, and Read one sample — the sample is AutoDiag's probe, not a selected subscriber), Graph (publisher to subscriber links, broken ones in red), Hosts (snapshots or a live collector URL plus AUTODIAG_AGENT_TOKEN; the Docker table runs docker on this process only), Transport (names this host vs the loaded peer; the dropdown is the expected transport, live DDS selection is not verified), Assistant (AI explanations; invented dds-autodiag commands are flagged after generation), Tools (tool check = fake fixtures; live rule check = every rule on this host and peer; live pair check = pick a real publisher and subscriber) and Settings (AI providers and keys). The header has Export snapshot and Download report.
